notes: Japan-market page (nintendo.co.jp), model USG-001. Axis mapping as for the DS: height=横133.0, width=縦73.9, depth=厚さ21.5 — Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width' (横), the reverse of this registry's key. Closed/folded state (折りたたみ時); open state not published, left null. Dimensions confirmed twice by Nintendo: the DS spec page and the 2008 DSi news release comparison table give identical figures. MASS DISCREPANCY: nintendo.co.jp states 約218g（バッテリーパック・タッチペン・ＧＢＡコネクタカバー含む） i.e. including the GBA connector cover; Nintendo of America's archived DS systems comparison page (web.archive.org snapshot 2010-08-06 of http://www.nintendo.com/ds/systems/compare) states '3" (diagonal measurement), 216g' with no inclusion list. Both are Nintendo primary; the Japanese figure is recorded because it states what is being weighed, and the 216 g NOA figure is flagged here rather than silently averaged. RESOLUTION ORDER: Nintendo writes '192×256ピクセル' (height×width); recorded as [256,192]. active_area_mm IS DERIVED: 256 × 0.24 mm dot pitch = 61.44 mm, 192 × 0.24 mm = 46.08 mm, both inputs quoted from this same page; cross-check sqrt(61.44²+46.08²) = 76.80 mm = 3.02 in vs Nintendo's stated 3インチ. Panel 透過型TFTカラー液晶 (transmissive TFT colour LCD) with 4-step brightness — differs from the original DS's transflective panel. announced = the date of Nintendo's own announcement news release. released = Japan launch; other regions not sourced from a Nintendo page. refresh_hz, materials, corner_radius, depth_at_hinge: not published, null. hinge.axis='long' from clamshell geometry, not a quoted line. controls[].position null — placement not stated in the spec text. CONTROLS CAVEAT: on the DS spec page the 主な操作部 row is a single merged cell spanning the DS Lite and DS columns, so Nintendo states one control list for both models; it is not a per-model line. ports: DS card slot and GBA cartridge slot omitted (no matching SPEC enum kind); Nintendo does not state the headphone jack's 3.5 mm diameter.
